headline: Bitcoin gave back its run at $85,000 and slipped under $83,000 in Asian trading after the US ordered non-emergency staff out of Saudi Arabia and oil rose to about $110.

market.asOf: BTC 22 Oct 02:19 UTC (09:19 Bangkok) via PANews citing OKX; HTX data at the same time showed +0.15% over 24h. ETH, SOL and Fear & Greed could not be read this run.

stories.title: Bitcoin gives back its run at $85,000 as the US orders staff out of Saudi Arabia
stories.summary: Bitcoin climbed close to $85,000 late Wednesday US time, then gave the gain back in Asian trading on Thursday. Over the same hours the US ordered non-emergency government staff and their families to leave Saudi Arabia, oil rose to about $110 a barrel, and Asian stocks and US stock futures fell.
points: CoinDesk (03:51 UTC) says bitcoin "topped out near $84,800 late Wednesday" and was "flat at just under $82,800" in Thursday's Asian morning (read at that time; live prices are at the top of the page).

At 02:19 UTC PANews reported bitcoin had fallen below $83,000 to $82,990, down 1.83% on the day on OKX. TechFlow, citing HTX at the same time, showed $82,945, up 0.15% over 24 hours: the daily change depends on the exchange and the starting point used.

The State Department ordered the departure of non-emergency US government employees and their families "in Saudi Arabia only", per CBS. Reuters reported officials planned to withdraw family members from other US missions in the region, so the scope is still unclear.
Brent oil rose $1.29, or 1.2%, to $110.11 a barrel at 00:34 GMT, per Reuters.
South Korea's Kospi fell 2.2% and Nasdaq 100 futures fell 1.1%, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Tesla books a $288M paper gain on its bitcoin; no terms agreed on a SpaceX merger
stories.summary: Tesla's third-quarter results include a gain on paper from the rise in value of the bitcoin it holds. It did not sell any. Separately, Elon Musk said committees at SpaceX and Tesla are looking at a merger, which would put about 30,000 bitcoin under one company, but no terms have been agreed.
points: Tesla's SEC filing shows a $288M pre-tax unrealized gain on digital assets in Q3, or $224M after tax.
Tesla reported $0.8B of GAAP net income for the quarter, per the same filing.
Tesla held 11,509 BTC at quarter-end, unchanged from the previous quarter, per Bloomingbit. SpaceX holds 18,712 BTC, 30,221 combined, per CoinDesk citing BitcoinTreasuries.net.
Musk said "the special committees have not reached agreement on the terms of any transaction," per CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk: SpaceX and Tesla explore merger

stories.title: The OCC finalizes its GENIUS Act stablecoin rule, and banks push back
stories.summary: The OCC, a federal bank regulator, issued a final rule putting the GENIUS Act stablecoin law into practice. It sets standards for the stablecoin issuers it oversees and bars them from paying interest-like yield directly to holders. The American Bankers Association says issuers can still offer equivalent yield through affiliates, exchanges and other partners.
points: The rule was issued on 21 Oct and applies from 18 Jan 2027, when the GENIUS Act takes effect, per Decrypt.
Whether a payment to stablecoin holders through an intermediary counts as banned yield will depend "on the facts and circumstances," the OCC wrote, per Banking Dive.
ABA CEO Rob Nichols said issuers "can provide economically equivalent yield while technically avoiding the statutory prohibition."
A new weekly reporting form for issuers starts with the 25 Jan 2027 report date, subject to approval by the Office of Management and Budget, per an OCC bulletin.

briefs.title: Bitcoin ETFs: inflows on 19 and 20 Oct
briefs.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs took in a net $526.6M on 19 Oct and $23.2M on 20 Oct, leaving October at about -$67.4M so far, per TFTC's flow tracker.

briefs.title: Ether ETF outflows pass $1B in October
briefs.summary: US spot Ether ETFs took in $26M on 20 Oct, but net outflows since the start of October total $1.08B, per SoSoValue data reported by FXStreet.

briefs.title: White House event on overseas crypto scams
briefs.summary: Ahead of Wednesday's event, a White House official said authorities had halted about $833M in fraudulent crypto transactions, seized 503 fraudulent sites and notified almost 9,000 US victims.

briefs.title: Drift hacker moves $109M of ether to Tornado Cash
briefs.summary: The wallet behind April's Drift Protocol hack sent about 44,510 ETH (around $109M) to the Tornado Cash mixer over 20-21 Oct and still holds about $138M.

briefs.title: Zcash jumps after setting an upgrade date
briefs.summary: ZEC rose about 11% in 24 hours to around $1,260 after developers set a November date for the NU7 upgrade, which cuts block times from 75 to 25 seconds.

briefs.title: Big companies object to tokenized versions of their shares
briefs.summary: Sixteen companies including Microsoft, Alphabet and Goldman Sachs objected to their shares trading in tokenized form on the OKXICE venue, removing 17 of 63 planned symbols before launch.
